qc.label_under_test: A verb of fitting or swapping a part in repair or assembly steps (install, insert, replace, fit, attach), esp. after 'and'; weaker for install used figuratively, and not for inject

neighbours.label: The verb that puts the new part or item in once the old one has been taken out ('remove X, then install / push in / lay Y'); the removal, cleaning and inspecting steps stay quiet
